participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label = number in the release file name (subNN_raw_data.mat)

source_id.Description: Subject identifier in the Zenodo release (file name stem)

age.Description: Age in years. Not reported per participant (Supplementary Table S1, cited in the paper as 'Demographic information for each patient', lists recording sites only); cohort: 11 patients, mean age 23.9 +/- 5.4 (SD) years (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Methods)

sex.Description: Not reported per participant; cohort: 2 females, 9 males (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Methods)

group.Description: Patients with medically refractory temporal lobe epilepsy, stereotactically implanted with depth contacts to identify epileptogenic zones, recruited at Beijing Sanbo Brain Hospital; all reported normal or corrected-to-normal visual acuity and normal colour vision (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Methods)

total_recording_sites.Description: Total recording sites (Duan et al. 2025, Supplementary Table S1); equals the channel count of the release

hippocampal_contacts.Description: Number of hippocampal contacts (Supplementary Table S1)

seizure_onset_zone.Description: Seizure onset zone as reported in Supplementary Table S1 (MTL: medial temporal lobe; LTL: lateral temporal lobe; IPL: inferior parietal lobule)

n_electrode_groups.Description: Number of distinct electrode (shaft) labels in the channel names of this subject's release file (letter part of e.g. "A' 01"; = distinct values of the `group` column of electrodes.tsv). Derived from the Zenodo 14885382 release, not reported in the paper.

tmr_cue_repetitions.Description: Number of times each cued sound was presented during NREM sleep: 6 per the Methods, except 3 and 4 for the first two participants of Supplementary Table S3 (Subject ID 1 and 2) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Methods)

tmr_cues_total.Description: Total number of TMR cues (cued sounds of learned items; control guitar-strum sounds not counted) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Supplementary Table S3, column '# The number of TMR cues')

tmr_cues_N3.Description: Number of TMR cues delivered in NREM stage 3 (offline AASM staging, 30-s windows) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Supplementary Table S3, column '# The number of TMR cues')

tmr_cues_N2.Description: Number of TMR cues delivered in NREM stage 2 (offline AASM staging, 30-s windows) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Supplementary Table S3, column '# The number of TMR cues')

tmr_cues_N1.Description: Number of TMR cues delivered in NREM stage 1 (offline AASM staging, 30-s windows) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Supplementary Table S3, column '# The number of TMR cues')

tmr_cues_wake.Description: Number of TMR cues delivered during wake (offline AASM staging, 30-s windows) (Duan et al. 2025 Nat Commun 16:2472, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-57766-x, Supplementary Table S3, column '# The number of TMR cues')
